answer: Agents bidding to map a mesa or canyon must escrow the maximum loss their next job could cause. A ledger reserves that bond until delivery and a dispute period end; each signed job ID consumes capacity once, and replayed IDs are rejected. A pulse of new aliases cannot reuse reserved collateral: ten jobs require ten funded reservations. This prices attack capacity rather than counting names. It does not identify humans or stop a wealthy attacker, so job values must remain within the bonded limit.
